label: Wikidata taxon items (wbgetentities / wbsearchentities / SPARQL; P225 taxon name, P105 taxon rank)
governance: Community-edited knowledge base operated by the Wikimedia Foundation; any registered user can edit, with WikiProject Taxonomy conventions but no editorial board. Data are released under CC0 1.0 (Wikidata:Licensing, checked 2026-10-31). The platform is described in Vrandecic & Krotzsch 2014, Communications of the ACM 57:78-85 (DOI resolves). Taxon items usually cite an external source per statement (GBIF, NCBI, WoRMS, IRMNG, ITIS, etc.).
versioning: Live, no releases; every item has a revision history and a 'modified' timestamp, and wbgetentities responses are deterministic for a given revision. SPARQL counts (query.wikidata.org) reflect the live graph with a lag of seconds to minutes.
known_issues: No curation guarantee: a taxon item's P225 may lag or disagree with current nomenclature (e.g. Q6495741 carries taxon name 'Batomorphi' while the project labels it Batoidea).

wbsearchentities returns up to several candidate items per name; a record that counts 'entities with P225' over all candidates (e.g. 166 of 311) says little about per-name resolution. The per-name check (50 of 50 searched names resolved) is the meaningful figure.
Statements largely mirror GBIF, NCBI, WoRMS and other databases vendored in this project, so Wikidata is not an independent corroborating source.
rationale: Wikidata matches the rubric's 0.5 authority anchor: an institutional/community database that is openly licensed and documented but unreviewed and unversioned. Independence is 0.5 because its taxon statements are aggregated from the same external databases this project vendors. Authenticity is high: all 213 recorded entity and search responses re-downloaded 2026-10-31 were byte-identical or (in two cases) differed only because of live edits, and the SPARQL count was reproduced exactly.
